database.name: MaterialProcessing
database.relatedDatabase: loginentry (users/rights; query as loginentry.dbo.LoginRights or loginentry..loginrights via cross-database SELECT from MaterialProcessing connection)

globalRules: Chatbot may only generate SELECT queries.
Always use TOP or another row limit unless the question is a COUNT aggregate.
Prefer exact status filter status = 'Pending' for pending work.
Approved statuses are often 'Approved' OR values like 'Approved by <username>'. Prefer status LIKE 'Approved%' when counting approved.
Rejected may appear as 'Rejected', 'Rejected by <username>', or rarely 'reject'.
SQL Server identifiers are case-insensitive under typical CI collation; column casing below matches live sys.columns.
Do not use *_temp, *_TEST, *_Delete, *_afterMail, or other non-allowlisted objects.

Ledger transaction statements in the portal use stored procedure sp_ac_LedgerSummary_BankRecoDate (not a simple SELECT). Chatbot SELECT scope for Ledger domain is FactoryInfo / LedgerMaster / CommonLedgerMaster. Avoid heavy views like vw_LedgerSummary unless explicitly needed and TOP-limited.
FactoryInfo.Name joins to LedgerMaster.CompanyName. Factory groups use FactoryInfo.GroupName. Portal company id uses FactoryInfo.SrNo (aka srno).

COLUMN NAME TRAP: FactoryInfo PAN column is PermanentAccountNo (NOT PANNo). LedgerMaster/CommonLedgerMaster PAN column is PANNo. Never select PANNo from FactoryInfo. FactoryInfo GST preferred column is NewGSTNo (also has GST).
GOVERNANCE: Ledger/account groups are LedgerMaster.Under (use SELECT DISTINCT Under ...). Do NOT use LedgerGroupMaster — that table is empty/unused for user-facing group lists.

GOVERNANCE: LedgerOpeningBalance table is EMPTY (0 rows). For opening/pending balance questions use LedgerMaster.Openingbalance and LedgerMaster.PendingBalance. Never query LedgerOpeningBalance. Named customer/vendor outstanding: LedgerMaster WHERE LedgerName LIKE '%party%' (optional CompanyName = our plant).

MRN / store inward: prefer Vw_StoreInwards or vw_MRNList for user questions. Header key SrNo joins StoreInwardsPayment.SrNo = StoreInwards.SrNo. MRN number is MRNo / MRno. BillPaymentEntry.MRNno joins StoreInwardsPayment.MRNo. Prefer TOP 50 — StoreInwards and WareHouseInwards are large. Skip *_old,*_GPL3,*_delete clones. Columns with spaces in vw_MRNToBillPayment (e.g. [Challan Date], [Basic Amount], [MRN User]) must be bracket-quoted.

GOVERNANCE (MRN): When user says 'for company X' / 'company X' / 'under X Limited' on material receipts, filter CompanyName = X. PartyName/SupplierName is the VENDOR/supplier only — use those when user says vendor, supplier, or party. Do not put the receiving company into PartyName.

COLUMN NAME TRAP (MRN): There is NO column named MRDate anywhere in MRN objects. Vw_StoreInwards / StoreInwardsPayment date columns are BillDate, GateInwardDate, SysDate, ChallanDate — never MRDate. vw_MRNList and BillPaymentEntry use MRNDate (spelled MRNDate, not MRDate). For 'recent' receipts ORDER BY BillDate or GateInwardDate DESC on Vw_StoreInwards.

GOVERNANCE (MRN names): Names like 'Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase' are PartyName (vendor), not CompanyName. Receiving companies look like 'Plastene Polyfilms Limited' / 'Plastene India Limited'. If the question asks for receipts 'for <name> with party and bill', treat <name> as PartyName when it is a vendor-style name (often ends with -Purchase).

GOVERNANCE (MRN payment): For 'payment against MRN / was payment raised / how much for material receipt X', prefer BillPaymentEntry WHERE MRNno = X (select PaymentNo, PaymentAmount, BillNo, UTRno, status, isPaid). vw_MRNToBillPayment is line-grain and often has NULL PaymentNo on unpaid lines — NEVER conclude 'no payment' from null rows alone. If using the view: WHERE MRno = X AND PaymentNo IS NOT NULL, SELECT DISTINCT PaymentNo, PaymentAmount.

GOVERNANCE (receipt by bill): For 'receipts linked to bill number X' / 'material receipt for bill X', filter Vw_StoreInwards.BillNo or StoreInwardsPayment.BillNo = X. Do NOT use BillPaymentEntry.BillNo for finding store receipts — that bill field is the payment-request bill and often does not match supplier bill numbers like PPL/D/540.

GOVERNANCE (Users): User master is loginentry.dbo.LoginRights (alias loginentry..loginrights). Username column is Name. NEVER SELECT Password. For email/full name/contact of a username use Email, FullName, ContactNo, EmpCode, Category. Role flags: IsAdmin, IsFinance, IsAccounts, IsPayroll, IsmaterialProc, IsMarketing, IsstoreHOD, ispurchasehod, isPaymentApprove (values often 'yes'/'no'). Join PurchasePayment.LoginName / BillPaymentEntry.Loginname / ApprovePO.ApprovalName to LoginRights.Name for requester/approver email. Prefer TOP 50. Do not SELECT * (hundreds of permission columns).

GOVERNANCE (PR/Quotation): Purchase requisitions use PurchaseReq / preferred view Vw_PurchaseReq (Code like CO/PR/yy-yy/...; NOT the same as IndentNo). Vendor quotations: prefer Vw_Quotation (FirmName, Rate, NegoRate, PurchaseCode, StoreCode). Vw_Quotation.PurchaseCode = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode / FinalQuotation.PurchaseCode. Vw_Quotation.StoreCode and Vw_IndentQuotation.Storecode join ApproveIndent.IndentNo. Indent-line quotes: Vw_IndentQuotation (SubCode joins ItemInfo.code). ApproveQuotation table is EMPTY — never use it. QuotationMaster is nearly empty — prefer Vw_Quotation. Always TOP 50 on these large views.

GOVERNANCE (Store outward / issue): Material issued from store uses StoreOutwards (~1.1M rows) — company column is CompName (NOT CompanyName). Issue document key is IssueSlipNo (varchar — always filter as string e.g. IssueSlipNo = '350', never unquoted int). 'issue slip' / 'what was issued' = StoreOutwards — NEVER despatch Invno. qty columns Qty / IssuedQty; destination IssueTo; department Deptt; warehouse WareHouse; date sysDate. Item name on StoreOutwards is ItemName; ItemInfo uses itemdesc. For daily inward vs outward by item prefer vw_ItemInwardOutward (ItemCode, InwardQty, Outwardqty, companyname, Date). 'Today' on these views: prefer latest available Date/sysDate for that company (MAX), not bare GETDATE() when posting lags. For month aggregates prefer vw_ItemMonthlyInwardOutward (Month, Year, MonthName, InwardQty, OutwardQty, companyname). Join StoreOutwards.Itemcode = ItemInfo.itemcode (NOT ItemInfo.code — that is indent subcode). Skip WarehouseStoreoutwards (multi-million, too heavy), empty Vw_StoreOutwardjobworkorder, and secondary StoreOutwards1 unless needed. Always TOP 50.

GOVERNANCE (Warehouse / stock): Current stock-in-hand uses WareHouse (StkInHand, Minlevel, Maxlevel, ReOrder, CompanyName, WareHouseName) or preferred simple view vw_itemwiseStock (Warehousename, CompanyName, ItemCode, ItemName, StkInHand). Richer inventory with groups: vw_inventoryitemwarehouse_all (Deptt, GroupName, SubGroupName, warehouse, unit). Warehouse master list: WareHouseMaster (companyname, warehousename). Company column is CompanyName / companyname — NOT CompName (that is StoreOutwards only). Join ItemCode/itemcode = ItemInfo.itemcode. For 'below reorder' filter StkInHand < ReOrder AND ReOrder > 0 on WareHouse. Skip broken vw_ItemStockLedger / VW_TradingStock, huge vw_stock_transactions, stale WareHouseOpeningStock (FY opening), session table warehousestock (no company), and multi-million WareHouseInwards/WarehouseStoreinwards (use MRN/outward domains instead). Always TOP 50.

GOVERNANCE (Debit/Credit notes): Purchase-side debit notes use DebitNote / preferred view vw_DebitNote (DebitNoteNumber like CO/DB/yy-yy/n or OEL/DB/26-27/16; TotalDebitAmount; PartyName = vendor; CompanyName = our company; DebitType often Provisional / Qty Difference / Rate Difference; links BillNo, MRNo, SrNo store inward). Sales-side credit notes use CreditNote / preferred view vw_creditnote (CreditNoteNumber like CO/CR/yy-yy/n; TotalCreditAmount / totalcreditamount; PartyName = customer; CompanyName = ours; CreditNoteDate; CreditType). CRITICAL: /DB/ in the number = debit note only; /CR/ = credit note only — never look up OEL/DB/... on vw_creditnote. Debit notes 'for <company>' / 'against MRN for <company>' → filter CompanyName with the full company name for ANY plant (Oswal Extrusion Limited, Plastene Polyfilms Limited, K.P. WOVEN PRIVATE LIMITED, HCP Plastene Bulkpack Ltd, etc.) — NEVER put the company into MRNo (MRNo is receipt id like RM 269). Example: 'polyfilms credit notes to Commercial Bag' → companyname = 'Plastene Polyfilms Limited' AND partyname = 'Commercial Bag Company' (~254 rows live) — NEVER partyname = 'Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase' or companyname = 'Commercial Bag Company'. *-Purchase names are vendors (debit/MRN PartyName only). Line items are sparse: DebitNoteItem ~179 rows, CreditNoteItem ~226 — most notes are header-only; prefer header/views unless user asks for item lines. DebitNote.MRNo joins StoreInwardsPayment.MRNo. Do NOT assume DebitNote.PONo joins PurchasePayment (0 matches live). Company vs party same as MRN: CompanyName is ours; PartyName is vendor/customer. Skip *_Delete, nearly empty DebitNote_Approval/CreditNote_Approval, and DebitNote_store unless needed. vw_creditnote has spaced column [Company Address] — bracket-quote. Always TOP 50.

GOVERNANCE (Vendor masters): Purchase vendor master is Vendor (~6.8k) — FirmName, VendorCode (Ven##### e.g. Bright Rubber=Ven00171), NewGSTNo, PANNo (tax PAN e.g. AACFB1249A — NOT VendorCode), Email, ContactName, Address/City/State, BankAccountNo/BankName/IFSCCode, PaymentTerms, ModeofPayment, ISMSME/MSMENumber, TypeVendor (Local/Import), IsClosed. Bank-details shortcut view: vw_VendorListwithBankdtls. Alternate snapshot: vendordata (FirmName + LedgerName, fewer rows). Join Vendor.FirmName to Vw_PurchaseOrder.FirmName / Vw_Quotation.FirmName / DebitNote.PartyName (LTRIM/RTRIM; names may include GST suffixes). Vendor.VendorCode joins Vw_PurchaseOrder.VendorCode. Pending/opening balance: LedgerMaster WHERE LedgerName LIKE '%FirmName%' or PANNo = Vendor.PANNo — NEVER LedgerMaster.PANNo = 'Ven00171'. Vendor is profile/bank/MSME, not full ledger statement. InternalVendor lists group companies treated as internal vendors. Always TOP 50.

GOVERNANCE (Vendor rates): Historical/vendor-item rates use VendorRate (~921k; preferred detailed) and Vw_VendorItem (~14.5M; slim ItemCode/FirmName/Rate/NegoRate/itemdesc). ALWAYS filter by FirmName and/or ItemCode (or SubCode) and ALWAYS TOP 50 — never SELECT without a selective WHERE. Prefer VendorRate for Rate/NegoRate/PaymentTerm/Discount/taxes; Vw_VendorItem when only itemdesc + rate list needed. For rates on a specific quotation/PO prefer Vw_Quotation (PurchaseCode/FirmName). VendorRate.FirmName joins Vendor.FirmName; ItemCode joins ItemInfo.itemcode; SubCode often joins ItemInfo.code (indent line). Example: Bright Rubber has recent VendorRate rows; WIP00013 has multiple vendors on VendorRate.

GOVERNANCE (Gate pass): Returnable gate pass (RGP) — prefer Vw_ReturnGatePass / ReturnGatePass (GatePassNo like CO/yy-yy/GP/n; CompName NOT CompanyName; ActualPartyName/PurposePartyName; ItemCode, Qty, Purpose). Non-returnable (NRGP) — prefer Vw_NonReturnGatePass / NonReturnGatePass (GatePassNo like CO/yy-yy/NGP/n; PartyName; CompName). Inward against returnable: InwdReturnGatePass (InwGatePassNo; GatePassNo links to ReturnGatePass when set). Pending returns: vw_returngatepasspending (ReturnQty, InwardQty, PendingQty — filter PendingQty > 0). Company column is CompName on all gate-pass objects. ItemCode joins ItemInfo.itemcode. Always TOP 50.

GOVERNANCE (Job work): Formal job-work orders are sparse (~7 headers / ~12 lines) — prefer Vw_EditJOBWorkOrder or Vw_JOBWORKORDER (PurchaseCode like PIL/JRO/... or PIL2/JWO/...; FirmName, ItemCode, JobWorkCharges, GatePassNo on edit view). Do NOT expect join to PurchasePayment/ApproveWorkOrder (0 matches live). Live MIS quantities: VW_JobWork_EBD_DTL (material at/sent job work by ItemCode, companyname) and VW_RECJOBWORK_EBD_DTL (received from job work with MRNo e.g. JBIN-SE). Prefer detail (_DTL) views over summary EBD. Returnable job-work movements also appear on Vw_ReturnGatePass WHERE Purpose LIKE '%Job Work%'. Skip empty Vw_StoreOutwardjobworkorder and tiny ApproveJOBWORKORDER. Always TOP 50; filter companyname/CompanyName and/or ItemCode on EBD views.

GOVERNANCE (Sales): Sales invoices/vouchers — prefer vw_Salesvoucher (header: InvNo, InvDate, BuyerName, BillAMount, CompanyName, InvType, TypeofInvoice, currency) or SalesVoucher. Line items: SalesVoucherItem (join CompanyName+InvNo; ITEMCODE, ItemName, ActualQty, Rate, Amount, HSNCODE). Compact list: vw_SalesInvList (Invno, DespatchDate, BuyerName, OrgInvno). Tax lines: SalesVoucherTax (TaxledgerName, Amount; CreditNoteNumber links sales credit notes). MIS item sales: VW_SALES_EBD_DTL (itemcode, qTY, InvNo, companyname). BuyerName is the customer. InvType values include Sales, Export Sales, Commercial Export Sales, Sales InterUnit, Job Invoice, etc. Top export customers: GROUP BY BuyerName, SUM(BillAMount), InvType LIKE '%Export%', Indian FY on InvDate (FY 2024-25 = 2024-04-01 to <2025-04-01); for company groups use FactoryInfo.GroupName/Name. Spaced columns on vw_Salesvoucher must be bracket-quoted e.g. [Company Address], [Company GST]. Sales credit notes remain CreditNote/vw_creditnote. Physical despatch/packing uses Despatch domain objects (not invoice headers alone). Always TOP 50.

GOVERNANCE (Despatch): Physical despatch/packing — ALWAYS filter CompanyName/Companyname and/or InvNo/Invno and/or PartyName/Partyname and/or date (sysdate/SysDate) and ALWAYS TOP 50 (tables are 200k–1.1M+). Roll despatch: prefer vw_MISrolldespatch (RollNO, Quality, NetWt, Companyname, Partyname, Invno, sysdate, PONO, PACKINGLISTNO on underlying MISRollforDespatch — prefer the view; do not also query MISRollforDespatch). FIBC bail despatch: FIBCDespatch (BailNo, Qty, Wt, InvNo, PACKINGLISTNO, PartyName, vVehicleNo). Yarn: MIS_YarnDespatch. Small bag bails: SmallBagBailForDespatch. Rolls waiting to despatch (no invoice yet): vw_RollforDespatch. Needle-loom rolls: MISNeedleRollforDespatch. Partyname/PartyName is customer/consignee. Link to sales invoice when InvNo matches vw_Salesvoucher.InvNo (formats vary — may need OrgInvno from vw_SalesInvList). Skip unused packing-list views that timeout.

GOVERNANCE (Production): Factory daily summary — prefer vw_FactoryProduction (companyname, Sysdate, Particulars e.g. Tape/Fabric/Small Bag/WEBBING, TapeProduction, Loom, Fabric, SmallBag, Wastage). Tape plant daily — vw_daily_tape_prod_New (CompanyName, date, Opening, Production, Closing; bracket spaced cols [Total Production], [Loom Dept], [FIBC Dept], [Wastage Dept]). Loom roll production — prefer vw_LoomProductionENtry (CompanyName, Sysdate, LoomNo, RollNo, Quality, NetWt, Metre, Partyname) — ~716k MUST filter CompanyName and/or Sysdate/LoomNo/RollNo + TOP 50. FIBC bag production — prefer VW_FIBCBagwiseProduction (NOT stale VW_FIBCBagwiseProduction_New which ends 2016); BagPCS, BagWt, TYPEOFBAG, TeamNO, PartyName, PONO. Item/plant MIS qty — VW_PRODUCTION_EBD_DTL (itemcode, Qty, PlantName, companyname, sysdate) — filter company/item/date + TOP 50. WIP by item/dept — vw_WIPReport (ItemCode, Qty, Consumption, Deptt, CompanyName, Date). Small-bag line — SmallBagProductionEntry (Cutting, Stitching, BagPcs, PartyName) — live data is mainly Plastene India / HCP Plastene units (~8k rows); Oswal Extrusion Limited has NO SmallBagProductionEntry rows (Oswal production is Tape/Fabric/WEBBING via vw_FactoryProduction and FIBC via VW_FIBCBagwiseProduction). Skip stale vw_Loom_Prod_Mtr / vw_daily_loom_Meter_Rep (last ~2023), empty/timeout vw_totalproductionconsumption / Vw_Prod_WIPLoom, dailyProductionReport/DailyTotalProduction (no company), huge raw MISLOOMProductionEntryNew / misneedleloomproductionentry / Prod_Cutting_InOut / TapePlantConsumption / stockJournalProd. Production ≠ despatch and ≠ ApproveWorkOrder. Always TOP 50.

objects.embeddingText: Table ApprovePO. Domain: Purchase order (PO) approval. Purpose: tracks each approver assignment on a purchase order for the standard (non-HOD) approval queue used by the PO approval portal. Columns: PoNo (PO number), ApprovalName (approver username), status (Pending, Approved, Approved by user, Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, TransId (unique row id). Joins: ApprovePO.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode = Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode; ApprovalName = POAllocation.username. Synonyms: pending PO, purchase order approval, PO waiting, standard PO queue. Filter pending with status = 'Pending'. For approved counts use status LIKE 'Approved%'.

Synonyms: HOD PO approval, head of department PO pending, ApprovePOHOD. Pending filter: status = 'Pending'.

objects.embeddingText: Table PurchasePayment. Domain: PO and work-order header commercial data. Purpose: TotalAmount, CompanyName, Currency, delivery and payment terms for a PurchaseCode. Not bill/vendor payment requests (those are BillPayment*). Columns include PurchaseCode (PK), TotalAmount, CompanyName, Currency, LoginName, TypeOfPO, DepttName, deliverydate, Payment terms text, PoSignal, taxes/discounts. Joins: PurchaseCode = ApprovePO.PoNo / ApproveWorkOrder.PoNo / Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode / FinalQuotation.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: PO amount, PO header total, purchase order value.

objects.embeddingText: Table BillPaymentEntry. Domain: Bill payment request details. Purpose: company, vendor, bill, MRN, amounts, bank, UTR, isPaid for a PaymentNo. Columns: PaymentNo, CompanyName, VendorName, BillNo, BillDate, MRNno (join to StoreInwardsPayment.MRNo / material receipt number), MRNDate, BillAmount, PaymentAmount, PaymentDate, status, UTRno, isPaid, IsCancel. PREFERRED for 'payment raised against MRN X / how much' => SELECT PaymentNo, MRNno, BillNo, PaymentAmount, BillAmount, status, isPaid FROM BillPaymentEntry WHERE MRNno = 'RM 269'. Join PaymentNo = BillPaymentHODApproval.paymentNo. Synonyms: payment details, bill payment entry, UTR, vendor bill, payment against material receipt.
